name: gitEnglish Hub
prompt_hint: Use a dark, premium editorial theme. Background `#0f1112`, card background `#16181a` (or `rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.3)`), accent color `#ff6b35` (burnt mandarin), secondary text `#9ca3af`, primary text `#e5e7eb`, border `#3f3f46`. TYPOGRAPHY RULES: Body and all metadata tags/chips use 'Roboto' sans-serif (17px). Headings use 'Outfit' font, weight 800 (H1=34px, H2=24px, H3=20px). DO NOT use monospace fonts or technical developer fonts anywhere. MINIMUM FONT SIZE: No text, metadata chip, rank badge, or label anywhere on the page can be smaller than 15px. ACCENT GRADIENT: Use a subtle gradient from burnt mandarin (#ff6b35) to burnt blood (#8a1c00) for structural accents like thin left-borders on cards (3-4px), subtle dividers under section headers. Layout Elements: Use a `.summary-box` class with a thin border and an absolutely positioned top-left `.summary-label` (uppercase, Roboto font, accent color). Use `.card` classes with the gradient left-border and flat backgrounds. All CSS must be inline in a single <style> tag. ICONS: Add these explicit CSS rules for SVG icons to make them large and premium: `svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; stroke-width: 2px; color: #ff6b35; margin-right: 12px; vertical-align: middle; }`. Do NOT use basic emojis, use clean, professional inline SVGs (like Lucide style) and apply the SVG sizing CSS.
print_css: @media print { @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 12mm; } body { background: #fff !important; color: #111 !important; } .container { max-width: 100% !important; width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; } .card, .summary-box, .section-break { break-inside: avoid !page-break-inside: avoid; } button[id='regenerate'] { display: none !important; } }
